measurementPolicy: project-specific release thresholds are enforced for every runtime transition

runtimeModel.previews: each action preview renders three action cycles followed by one 6x-duration idle cycle; the idle preview renders one 6x-duration idle cycle

metricDefinitions.normalizedCompositedRgbDifference: sum(abs(toRGB-over-stage - fromRGB-over-stage)) / (255 * 3 * cellPixelCount); straight-alpha sRGB-channel compositing
metricDefinitions.changedPixelFraction: count(alphaTo != alphaFrom) / cellPixelCount; exact lossless alpha comparison
metricDefinitions.changedCompositedPixelFraction: count(any composited RGB channel differs) / cellPixelCount
metricDefinitions.silhouetteIou: intersection / union of source-cell pixels whose alpha is at least 128
metricDefinitions.silhouetteCentroidStepPx: Euclidean distance between alpha-at-least-128 silhouette centroids in source-cell pixels
